purpose: Find an already-existing or already-entitled persistent host that can run the independently validating FAE reference node without consuming Stability Soak capacity or a new unapproved budget.

reasons: No currently running persistent service is available.
Existing WAN/soak services belong to other bounded workstreams.
Stability Soak V3 Render capacity is reserved and must not be consumed by Explorer.
Existing projects are application/audit deployments, not a persistent independently validating node with node-owned durable state.
Wallet/Mining and audit projects cannot be repurposed as Explorer node authority.
The verified FAE Explorer deployment is frontend-only and UNBOUND.
No existing AppDeploy app observed in this scan is an independently validating persistent FAE node.
